means: A short focal length: takes in more of the scene and bends straight lines outward toward the edges, exaggerating the difference between near and far.
does: On this model it mostly buys FRAMING, not geometry. The shot_lens_look wide and ultra_wide panels are simply wider shots - more stadium, smaller figure - which is what "wide shot" already gives you, with very little of the edge stretch or the looming near-object the term promises. The project's own review of the neighbouring card is blunter still: millimetre numbers are inert tokens here and the compression axis is not separable from lens look at all.
reach_for_it: when you want more environment in frame and are happy for that to be the whole effect. If you actually need visible lens geometry, use fisheye, which really does bend the picture.
used_in: shot.lens.look wide and ultra_wide; shot.lens.compression expanded, a card whose own review recommends marking it unrenderable because it duplicates lens look
